items.title: Ask HN: Code review of AI output, review what?
items.summary: If AI is supposed to be doing a better job at coding, then what are humans reviewing in it? I don't understand why I need to spend extra time and effort just to read code that humans aren't supposed to write. I feel this is some sort of scam in the AI industry telling us to do code reviews. Either write the code yourself or just pass all the AI code. Please help me understand. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49559036 Points: 4 # Comments: 2
